bridge.eyebrow: Why a Puja talks about farms
bridge.title: The gathering names the farmer. The farm is what you can help seed.
bridge.body: Durga Puja is when Bengal comes home. This Pujo puts the annadata — the farmer who feeds the household — in view, honours that work, and then shows Integrated Farming as a livelihood on small land. If you live away from Bengal, this is how you can take part: not by watching a festival from afar, but by helping seed a village farm.

storyArc.lede: Six steps. Each one follows from the last. You do not need insider language to follow them.

steps.title: A gathering people can join
steps.body: This Sharadiya, the Puja is the public meeting-place: neighbourhood, clay, dhak, food, homecoming. Neighbours in Kolkata and Bengalis living away from Bengal can enter the work here.

steps.title: The annadata comes into view
steps.body: The gathering is not only spectacle. It names the farmer who grows food, so the person who feeds Bengal is seen — not left unnamed.

steps.title: An award ceremony for the unknown farmer
steps.body: An award ceremony on Ashtami evening recognises the unnamed farmer — people Bengal does not usually photograph. Nominations are open on this site. There is no entry fee.

steps.title: Why Integrated Farming follows
steps.body: Once the farmer is in view, the next question is livelihood. Integrated Farming keeps crop, animals, water and market on one holding, so leftover becomes input — a model a small farm can run.

steps.title: See it on a live farm
steps.body: That model is being built as a working farm at Munshir Bheri Management / Fishermen's Committee, Near Sukantanagar / Salt Lake Sector V, (East Kolkata Wetlands), Kolkata – 700091, West Bengal — the same location named for the Puja venue.

steps.title: This Puja is the seed
steps.body: This Durga Puja is the public beginning of a mobilisation target: about 5,000 integrated farms. ₹1 lakh is the proposed seed for one village farm — or ₹20,000 every two months — with one NRB patron each, from Puja 2026 to Puja 2027. That is a goal, not money already collected.
